summary: V50.z558 Google Drive refresh frequency + reindex status + manual reindex: 18/18 backend pytest PASSED against preview backend; _drive_refresh_due logic replica validated against pymongo-seeded docs (manual→False, daily-2h→False, hourly-2h→True, no-last-run→True, weekly-6d→False, weekly-8d→True) with proper cleanup. Frontend callback page shows 'Collegamento fallito' + 'Parametri mancanti (code o state)' + 'Torna alle impostazioni' button on missing params and the button navigates to /google-drive. /google-drive and /google-drive?oauth=google&status=ok render WITHOUT any window.alert/window.confirm popups (hook-captured) and without a 'Not authenticated' banner. NOTE: Expo frontend targets prod backend core.axonos.cloud (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL) which is NOT yet deployed with the new endpoints — /api/google-drive/refresh-frequency returns 404 and /api/google-drive/reindex/status returns the pre-V50.z558 shape (missing failed_files, refresh_frequency keys). This is deployment-pending, not a code bug. gd-freq-card + gd-refresh-now-btn UI code is present in /app/frontend/app/google-drive.tsx and renders only when Drive is 'Collegato' (which it is NOT on prod for this account, so the pills can't be exercised live until prod is updated).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/34_alarms_homeassistant.py: _drive_refresh_due subtracts 60s from 'every' threshold — correct scheduling tolerance since the periodic job runs ~every 30 min. Logic verified across 6 scenarios.

/app/frontend/app/auth/google/callback.tsx: redirect target uses /google-drive?oauth=google&status=ok and router.replace (not window.location) so SPA session is preserved — correctly prevents the 'Not authenticated' popup on return.
/app/frontend/app/google-drive.tsx L50-52: when GET /google-drive/status fails during OAuth return, uses notify() (non-blocking toast) instead of window.alert — matches the 'no popup' requirement.
